subject: A Smart City built on files, and a village that walks in
alt: Satish Acharya’s cartoon: a long wooden plank rests on a high stack of papers and files, slanting up from left to right. At the far right, in a green village with huts and trees, men, women and children carrying bundles walk along the plank towards the city. At the left, a city of tall blue glass towers is melting and dripping down, its debris scattered in a puddle and flowing away. A card hanging below the stack reads ‘स्मार्ट सिटी मिशन’ (Smart City Mission). A speech bubble at the upper left says ‘मेरा शहर मेरा देश’ (My city, my country). Satish Acharya’s signature is at the lower right.
chutki: The plank rests on a tall stack of paper files; from the village at the far end, people with bundles walk along it towards the city. The blue city ahead is melting and dripping, and the card under the stack reads ‘Smart City Mission’.

The needle: the city stands on paperwork, which is why it is melting, but for those walking in from the village this plank is the only road. The slogan ‘my city, my country’ belongs to a city that is dripping under their feet.
